alt: A formal letter from the California Board of Registered Nursing (BRN) dated August 10, 2026, confirming the closure of the clinical misconduct complaint against Kenneth Ezenwa, NP, in Case No. 4002026009197.
full_text: BOARD OF REGISTERED NURSING. 1747 N. Market Blvd. Suite 150, Sacramento, CA 95834. August 10, 2026. NICOLAS HERNANDEZ. Re: KENNETH EZENWA. Dear NICOLAS HERNANDEZ, This letter is in response to the complaint that was filed with the Board of Registered Nursing (BRN) on June 12, 2026. In reviewing complaints, diligent efforts are made to ensure that every allegation is properly reviewed. The BRN is authorized to take disciplinary action only against those Registered Nurses it finds in violation of the Nursing Practice Act, and must determine whether administrative action in the form of discipline (i.e. imposing limitations or restrictions on a license) is appropriate. The BRN pursues discipline in those cases where there is a clear indication that formal charges can be successfully prosecuted by the Attorney General's Office. The BRN has closed this complaint as a final disposition in Case No. 4002026009197. Sincerely, Shannon Johnson, Enforcement Division Chief.
